steps.title: Branch, plan, pinned dependencies (D-0401), config, scaffold
steps.summary: Branch phase-04-relay from main (Phases 0-3 merged as fbb5640). Twelve-step plan written. Relay deps pinned (D-0401): opaque-ke 4.0.1 (ristretto255, identity KSF per D-0102), sqlx 0.9, axum 0.8, tower-governor 0.8, tower-http 0.7. rusqlite 0.39 in core so libsqlite3-sys unifies with sqlx in one binary. Config from TOML + STUDGE_RELAY_* env with strict unknown-key rejection; generic error model (SPEC 7.8); security headers; request timeout with the JSON error shape.

steps.title: OPAQUE in core + register/login with the dummy flow
steps.summary: OPAQUE wrappers in core (commit 8c2b9bd). register/start, register/finish, login/start, login/finish, logout. Dummy exchange for unknown accounts (D-0113).

steps.title: Sessions: tokens, SHA-256 storage, device binding, revocation
steps.summary: 256-bit OsRng tokens, stored as SHA-256. 24-hour expiry. Device-bound. Login-state table (0002). take_login_state is atomic DELETE-RETURNING.

steps.title: Storage: sqlx SQLite migrations and the store
steps.summary: migrations/0001 (accounts, devices, vaults, ops, sessions, counters) + 0002 (login_states). RelayStore with all required methods.

steps.title: Account and device endpoints
steps.summary: GET/PUT/DELETE /v1/account (If-Match versioning), POST /v1/devices (certificate + enrolment proof), DELETE /v1/devices/{id} (signed revocation).

steps.title: Vault endpoints: ops push/fetch, head compare-and-swap
steps.summary: POST/GET /v1/vaults/{id}/ops (append-only, idempotent, paginated, implicit vault creation). GET/PUT /v1/vaults/{id}/head (CAS with If-Match).

steps.title: Quotas and rate limits
steps.summary: Per-IP and per-account fixed-window counters. Storage quota check before every push. All limits from SPEC §7.7 enforced.

steps.title: Hardening: headers, CORS, timeouts, log hygiene
steps.summary: Security headers on every response (nosniff, no-store, no-referrer, DENY, CSP). 30-second request timeout. Generic errors (§7.8). CorsLayer wired in app() with strict allowlist (8363cd3).

steps.title: Docs: relay-api, relay-asvs, Caddy, Docker
steps.summary: docs/relay-api.md (all endpoints, examples). docs/relay-asvs.md (ASVS 4.0 Level 3). Dockerfile (multi-stage, non-root). docker-compose.yml + Caddyfile.

steps.title: Integration tests on a random port
steps.summary: 11 black-box HTTP tests: register/login, wrong password, duplicate account, logout, vault ops push/fetch, head CAS conflict, vault isolation, malformed inputs. 301 total tests, 0 failed.

steps.title: relay_tour demo and the preview Relay section
steps.summary: Planned but not completed (turn limit reached). Follow-up issue to be filed.

steps.title: PROGRESS, self-attack review, issues, PR
steps.summary: PROGRESS.md updated. THREAT_MODEL.md §18: 14 vectors, 12 blocked, 5 new risks R-0401..R-0405. Security issues #43-#46 filed. PR #47 opened. CORS wired. deny.toml RUSTSEC-2026-0387 excepted.

try_it.label: Start the relay
try_it.expect: studge-relay listening on http://127.0.0.1:8787; GET /health answers {"status":"ok"}.

risks.title: R-0001 — CodeQL code scanning skipped while the repository is private (issue #23)
R-0103 — A cloned VM or broken RNG could repeat a nonce; mitigated by OsRng-only random and no software fallback
R-0108 — A weak master password plus a stolen Secret Key allows offline guessing; Argon2id 64 MiB/t=3/p=1 is the mitigation
R-0116 — Vault-key wrapping is X25519-only; hpke 0.15 now ships X-Wing, so Phase 11 can switch
R-0117 — test-vectors feature exposes fixed-nonce sealing; documented test-only, never in release builds
R-0118 — The Secret Key check character is 5 bits: a typo inside the alphabet has a 1-in-32 chance of passing and then fails safely at the MUK
R-0119 — HPKE base mode gives no sender authentication; correct for vault-key wrapping, must not be presented as authentication
R-0401 — No email notification on account lockout; rate limit enforced, notification is Phase 8 (issue #43)
R-0403 — Malicious relay operator can delete OPAQUE credential; mitigation in Phase 13 (issue #44)
R-0404 — Malicious relay can serve forged identity key; mitigation in Phase 11 key transparency (issue #45)
R-0405 — crypto-bigint 0.5.5 timing side-channel (RUSTSEC-2026-0387) via opaque-ke; ristretto255 hot paths use curve25519-dalek not crypto-bigint (D-0402); excepted in deny.toml (issue #46)
